symptom: A non-slow runtime-adoption integration case failed its initial connected assertion while a valid first worker configuration was still pending beyond Vitest's one-second default poll window.
rule: The CI-red playbook requires a controlled wait at the real producer boundary. Hold the first configuration response beyond the default poll window, use the existing five-second fixture I/O allowance for initial connection, and join that bootstrap before teardown. Preserve the exact connected matcher, the 35-second case budget and every production deadline.
